title: ci(news): add a practice-only news posts workflow
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added a manual-only news posts workflow for practice runs. It can prepare a single daily, weekly, or monthly post, or run a morning sequence that prepares the daily post, the weekly post on Sundays, and the monthly post on the 1st, in that order. It uses posts.py to write into a sparse checkout of news, saves the results, and prints the staged diff. It has no push step, delivery job, or posting keys. Planned practice runs cover a recent daily and weekly post against news, plus the morning of 2026-03-01, which is both a Sunday and the 1st.
